title: Huerta Group LLC — Institutional Knowledge Metadata Schema
description: Defines document records and the corpus manifest for the governed docs/ corpus. Formalizes the existing documentation governance in docs/README.md; metadata described by this schema indexes knowledge and never creates institutional authority. See institution/decisions/adr-0001-institutional-knowledge-foundation.md.

corpus.description: Explicit canonical corpus scope and exclusion rule (ADR-0001 as rescoped by the Repository Foundation migration; see ADR-0007).

id.description: Stable human-readable kebab-case identifier, derived from the filename stem (documented exception: the documentation index uses 'documentation-index' because its stem, README, is a filesystem convention). Never positional, never a timestamp.

path.description: Canonical repository-relative path within the corpus roots (institution/, docs/) or an explicitly governed root-level operational instruction file.

type.description: Technical document kind (indexing convenience only; carries no authority).

classification.description: The repository's established classification taxonomy (docs/README.md), reused verbatim. 'Unspecified' transparently marks documents whose classification no governing reference states — it is a gap, not a category. Extending the taxonomy requires institutional authority, not a schema edit.

authorityTier.description: Position in the hierarchy of authority (docs/README.md): 1 Constitution, 2 Vision Foundation, 3 other approved Company-wide documents, 4 Development Standards and approved architecture decisions, 5 individual task instructions. 'non-governing' = describes rather than governs. 'unspecified' = governing references are silent; awaiting owner decision.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the record's document.

statusNote.description: Optional nuance the source document itself states (e.g. pending verbatim constitutional text).

summary.description: Concise identification/discovery summary. Never a substitute for reading the document.

provenance.description: Recorded only where a repository document states it; null means 'not stated by any governing reference' — never fabricate.

versioning.description: Git history is the version record; no parallel numbering (ADR-0001).

rel.description: Smallest vocabulary the corpus justifies (ADR-0001). Relationships never imply authority beyond what the linked documents state.

disclosure.description: Only what current repository evidence supports. A fuller disclosure taxonomy requires separate authorization; values here never change actual visibility.

machineConsumptionEligible.description: Whether the document could later be eligible for machine/AI consumption. 'unresolved' until an authorized governance decision exists; this field never itself authorizes any system.

historicalPreservation.description: Optional; how the document's history is preserved. Default expectation is git-history (ADR-0001).

unresolved.description: Transparent list of metadata questions awaiting institutional decisions for this document.
